segments.he: וְכֵן לְעִנְיַן טוּמְאָה, אִם מַקְפִּיד עָלָיו — חוֹצֵץ, וְאִם רוֹצֶה בְּקִיּוּמוֹ — הֲרֵי הוּא כַּעֲרֵיבָה.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «And similarly, with regard to» the halakhot of immersion to purify the bowl from «ritual impurity, if one is particular about» the dough that is stuck in the cracks and he plans to remove it and use it, «it» is a foreign substance that «interposes» between the kneading bowl and the water of the ritual bath, and invalidates the immersion of the bowl, leaving it ritually impure. «And if he wants» the dough «to remain» in place, «its» status «is like» that «of the» kneading «bowl» itself and is not an interposition.

moves.summary: quotes the mishna's impurity clause for discussion
